expectation.text: Typing after the idle screensaver or the Quickshell lock overlay should produce exactly the characters pressed, as it did earlier in the same session.

payload.introduced_by: Installing plugin io.github.heroesofcode.omacento built from an unreleased commit (manifest version 2.0.0, dated 21-Sep) whose fcitx5 add-on consumed keydown events and only emitted the letter on key release.
payload.observed: After the idle screensaver (60 s) or a lock on Omarchy's Quickshell lock screen, letters a e i o u c n y s z (and their capitals) disappeared mid-word and fast typing came out scrambled, so the unlock attempt failed with repeated authentication-failure entries for the omarchy-lock PAM service in the journal; the session could only be recovered by holding the power button (three forced reboots in one evening). Turning the widget's accents off stopped the interference immediately; turning them back on brought it back.
payload.title: Screensaver and lock overlay drop accented letters typed through an fcitx5 long-press add-on
